config.validation_rule: For outer test fold k, fold (k+1) mod 5 is validation and the other three folds are training; no patient crosses partitions.
config.schedule: 20-epoch cosine decay to 1% of initial learning rate; no early stopping
config.augmentation: uniform rotations by multiples of 90 degrees and horizontal flip with probability 0.5
config.preprocessing: per-image 1st-99.5th percentile grayscale normalization; grayscale replicated to three channels; Gabor model adds the fixed 24-filter edge channel
config.precision: bfloat16 autocast with float32 loss and finite gradient checks
config.selection: highest complete validation image-mean Dice; fixed threshold 0.5; no test-time augmentation
config.primary_endpoint: patient-macro native-grid Dice from out-of-fold predictions
config.status: Exploratory grouped cross-validation; TNBC labels had previously been inspected during zero-shot analysis.
